caption: The drawing is composed of three main sections arranged on a single sheet of light beige paper. At the top left is a pencil outline of a vase with a wide body, narrow neck, and flared rim, positioned within a square frame; inside the vase, there is a stylized decorative motif resembling a symmetrical plumed or floral shape. To the right, also within a square frame, the same decorative motif is isolated and drawn in pencil with no vase, showing five curved, petal-like shapes radiating upwards and outwards from a central circular base. Below these two squares, centered on the page, is a large horizontal brown rectangle filled with a textured, darker brown color. Within the rectangle, the same stylized motif is rendered in solid black, occupying most of the brown area. At the bottom left corner of the page outside the drawings, the name "JESSICA PRICE" is printed in small, uppercase, gray letters.
title: Jar
